EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Nodes == {"n1", "n2", "n3"}
NONE == "none"
MaxCap == 3

VARIABLES leader, alive, epoch, driver, cap

vars == <<leader, alive, epoch, driver, cap>>

Init ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ alive = Nodes
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ driver = NONE
    /\ cap = 1

Elect(n) ==
    /\ n \in alive
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<alive, driver, cap>>

Acquire(n) ==
    /\ n = leader
    /\ n \in alive
    /\ driver = NONE
    /\ driver' = n
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive, epoch, cap>>

Release(n) ==
    /\ driver = n
    /\ driver' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive, epoch, cap>>

LeaderFail ==
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ driver = NONE
    /\ alive' = alive \ {leader}
    /\ leader' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, driver, cap>>

ChangeCap(c) ==
    /\ c \in 1..MaxCap
    /\ c # cap
    /\ cap' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive, epoch, driver>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Acquire(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Release(n)
    \/ LeaderFail
    \/ \E c \in 1..MaxCap : ChangeCap(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {NONE}
    /\ alive \subseteq Nodes
    /\ epoch \in 0..10
    /\ driver \in Nodes \cup {NONE}
    /\ cap \in 1..MaxCap

DriverIsLiveLeader ==
    (driver # NONE) => (driver = leader /\ driver \in alive)

====

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT DriverIsLiveLeader
nl:
An airport baggage router coordinates several router nodes that share a single
high-speed sorting belt. Only one node may drive the belt at a time, and the
node that drives it must be the currently elected leader. Leadership is granted
by epoch-numbered election over the set of nodes still alive; a leader can fail
silently, after which a surviving node is elected in a higher epoch. The belt's
throughput capacity is reconfigured at runtime (raised or lowered) to match the
incoming bag load, but a capacity change never transfers who is driving the belt.
A node acquires the belt only while it is the leader and alive, and it must
release the belt before failing or before a new leader takes over.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever the sorting belt is being driven, its driver is the current leader and is still alive.

LeaderFail ==

    /\ alive' = alive \ {leader}
    /\ leader' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, seated, cap>>

Admit(p) ==
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ leader \in alive
    /\ p \notin seated
    /\ Cardinality(seated) < cap
    /\ seated' = seated \cup {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive, epoch, cap>>

    /\ p \in seated
    /\ seated' = seated \ {p}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive, epoch, cap>>

    /\ c \in 1..MaxCap
    /\ c # cap
    /\ c >= Cardinality(seated)
    /\ cap' = c
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, alive, epoch, seated>>

    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
    \/ LeaderFail
    \/ \E p \in Players : Admit(p)
    \/ \E p \in Players : Leave(p)

    /\ alive \subseteq Nodes
    /\ epoch \in 0..10

    Cardinality(seated) <= cap

====

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT WithinCapacity
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker seats players into a single match lobby. One
matchmaker node is the elected leader and is the only node allowed to admit
players; leadership is decided by epoch-numbered election over the nodes still
alive, and the leader can fail silently and be replaced in a higher epoch. The
lobby has a seat capacity that operators reconfigure at runtime as server load
shifts, but capacity is never lowered below the number of players already seated.
The leader admits a waiting player only when a free seat exists, players may leave
at any time, and a failed leader stops admitting until a new one is elected.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of players seated in the lobby never exceeds the lobby's current seat capacity.

---- MODULE W4Od6m0p5t5 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Cars == {"c1", "c2"}
MaxVer == 2

VARIABLES version, status, cut, pulses, snap

vars == <<version, status, cut, pulses, snap>>

Init ==
    /\ version = [c \in Cars |-> 0]
    /\ status = [c \in Cars |-> "active"]
    /\ cut = {}
    /\ pulses = [c \in Cars |-> 0]
    /\ snap = [c \in Cars |-> 0]

Bump(c) ==
    /\ status[c] \in {"active", "retiring"}
    /\ version[c] < MaxVer
    /\ version' = [version EXCEPT ![c] = version[c] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<status, cut, pulses, snap>>

Snapshot(c) ==
    /\ status[c] = "active"
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![c] = "retiring"]
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![c] = version[c]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, cut, pulses>>

Retry(c) ==
    /\ status[c] = "retiring"
    /\ snap[c] # version[c]
    /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![c] = version[c]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, status, cut, pulses>>

Commit(c) ==
    /\ status[c] = "retiring"
    /\ snap[c] = version[c]
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![c] = "retired"]
    /\ cut' = cut \cup {c}
    /\ pulses' = [pulses EXCEPT ![c] = pulses[c] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, snap>>

AdminOverride(c) ==
    /\ status[c] \in {"active", "retiring"}
    /\ status' = [status EXCEPT ![c] = "retired"]
    /\ cut' = cut \cup {c}
    /\ pulses' = [pulses EXCEPT ![c] = pulses[c] + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<version, snap>>

Idle ==
    /\ \A c \in Cars : status[c] = "retired"
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ Idle
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Bump(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Snapshot(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Retry(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Commit(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cars : AdminOverride(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ version \in [Cars -> 0..MaxVer]
    /\ status \in [Cars -> {"active", "retiring", "retired"}]
    /\ cut \subseteq Cars
    /\ pulses \in [Cars -> 0..3]
    /\ snap \in [Cars -> 0..MaxVer]

BreakerTrippedOnce ==
    \A c \in Cars :
        /\ pulses[c] <= 1
        /\ (c \in cut) = (pulses[c] = 1)
        /\ (c \in cut) = (status[c] = "retired")

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT BreakerTrippedOnce
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper retires cars for maintenance by cutting their
traction breaker, which is a physically irreversible action: once a car's breaker
is tripped it is decommissioned and can never be re-energized. A controller uses
optimistic locking to retire a car safely. It snapshots the car's configuration
version, and may commit the breaker trip only if the version has not changed in
the meantime; if a concurrent reconfiguration bumped the version, the controller
must re-snapshot and retry rather than trip. A privileged admin override may trip
the breaker immediately without matching the snapshot. Whether via the optimistic
path or the admin override, a car's breaker must be tripped exactly once.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Each car's traction breaker is tripped at most once, and a car counts as decommissioned exactly when its breaker has been tripped.

EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Nodes == {"n1", "n2"}
Slots == {"s1", "s2"}
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES leader, epoch, slow, sealed, sealer, seals

vars == <<leader, epoch, slow, sealed, sealer, seals>>

Init ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ slow = {}
    /\ sealed = {}
    /\ sealer = [s \in Slots |-> NONE]
    /\ seals = [s \in Slots |-> 0]

Elect(n) ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ epoch < 4
    /\ n \notin slow
    /\ leader' = n
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<slow, sealed, sealer, seals>>

StepDown ==
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ leader' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, slow, sealed, sealer, seals>>

BecomeSlow(n) ==
    /\ n \notin slow
    /\ slow' = slow \cup {n}
    /\ leader' = IF leader = n THEN NONE ELSE leader
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, sealed, sealer, seals>>

Recover(n) ==
    /\ n \in slow
    /\ slow' = slow \ {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, epoch, sealed, sealer, seals>>

Seal(s) ==
    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ leader \notin slow
    /\ s \notin sealed
    /\ sealed' = sealed \cup {s}
    /\ seals' = [seals EXCEPT ![s] = seals[s] + 1]
    /\ sealer' = [sealer EXCEPT ![s] = leader]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, epoch, slow>>

Idle ==
    /\ sealed = Slots
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
    \/ StepDown
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : BecomeSlow(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Recover(n)
    \/ \E s \in Slots : Seal(s)
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {NONE}
    /\ epoch \in 0..4
    /\ slow \subseteq Nodes
    /\ sealed \subseteq Slots
    /\ sealer \in [Slots -> Nodes \cup {NONE}]
    /\ seals \in [Slots -> 0..3]

SealedOnceByLeader ==
    \A s \in Slots :
        /\ seals[s] <= 1
        /\ (s \in sealed) = (seals[s] = 1)
        /\ (s \in sealed) => (sealer[s] \in Nodes)
        /\ (s \notin sealed) => (sealer[s] = NONE)

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT SealedOnceByLeader
nl:
A container-ship crane yard secures containers into fixed ship slots. Sealing a
slot is irreversible: once a container is welded into a slot it is permanent and
that slot can never be sealed again. Crane controllers coordinate through leader
election with failover; only the elected leader may command a seal, and the leader
is chosen among controllers by epoch, stepping down on failover so a replacement
can take over. A controller can be slow but never fails outright: a slow controller
cannot be elected leader, and a sitting leader that becomes slow must step down
before it lags. Every sealed slot records the controller that sealed it.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Each ship slot is sealed at most once, and every sealed slot records the leader that performed the single seal.

vars == <<token, ledger, cursor, pending>>

Init ==
    /\ token = "n1"
    /\ ledger = [i \in 0..(K-1) |-> NONE]
    /\ cursor = 0
    /\ pending = [n \in Nodes |-> FALSE]

PassToken ==
    /\ token' = Succ(token)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ledger, cursor, pending>>

RequestUpdate(n) ==
    /\ ~ pending[n]
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![n] = TRUE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, ledger, cursor>>

CommitUpdate(n) ==
    /\ token = n
    /\ pending[n]
    /\ cursor < K
    /\ ledger' = [ledger EXCEPT ![cursor] = n]
    /\ cursor' = cursor + 1
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED token

CancelRequest(n) ==
    /\ pending[n]
    /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![n] = FALSE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, ledger, cursor>>

Idle ==
    /\ cursor = K
    /\ \A n \in Nodes : ~ pending[n]
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : RequestUpdate(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : CommitUpdate(n)

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdates
nl:
A library book reservation system serializes writes to a shared reservation
ledger using a token ring: three reservation nodes are arranged in a ring, a
single token circulates, and only the node currently holding the token may append
a reservation to the ledger. Two independent branch instances share the same
underlying book pool, so their appends land in one common ledger. Each append is
written to the next free ledger slot, which is then advanced. Because the token
grants exclusive write access, appends are serialized and no earlier reservation
is ever overwritten or lost: the filled ledger slots are always exactly the prefix
below the write cursor, with no gaps and no double-filled slot.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The ledger slots that hold a reservation are exactly the contiguous prefix below the write cursor, so no reservation is overwritten or lost.

---- MODULE W4Od16m5p6t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Voters == {"v1", "v2", "v3"}
Quorum == 2
MaxEpoch == 2

VARIABLES gepoch, vepoch, votes, committed, slow

vars == <<gepoch, vepoch, votes, committed, slow>>

Init ==
    /\ gepoch = 0
    /\ vepoch = [v \in Voters |-> 0]
    /\ votes = {}
    /\ committed = FALSE
    /\ slow = {}

Rotate ==
    /\ gepoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ gepoch' = gepoch + 1
    /\ votes' = {}
    /\ committed' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<vepoch, slow>>

Sync(v) ==
    /\ v \notin slow
    /\ vepoch[v] < gepoch
    /\ vepoch' = [vepoch EXCEPT ![v] = gepoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gepoch, votes, committed, slow>>

BecomeSlow(v) ==
    /\ v \notin slow
    /\ slow' = slow \cup {v}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gepoch, vepoch, votes, committed>>

Recover(v) ==
    /\ v \in slow
    /\ slow' = slow \ {v}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gepoch, vepoch, votes, committed>>

Vote(v) ==
    /\ v \notin slow
    /\ vepoch[v] = gepoch
    /\ v \notin votes
    /\ ~ committed
    /\ votes' = votes \cup {v}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gepoch, vepoch, committed, slow>>

Commit ==
    /\ ~ committed
    /\ Cardinality(votes) >= Quorum
    /\ committed' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gepoch, vepoch, votes, slow>>

Idle ==
    /\ committed
    /\ gepoch = MaxEpoch
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ Rotate
    \/ \E v \in Voters : Sync(v)
    \/ \E v \in Voters : BecomeSlow(v)
    \/ \E v \in Voters : Recover(v)
    \/ \E v \in Voters : Vote(v)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ gepoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ vepoch \in [Voters -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ votes \subseteq Voters
    /\ committed \in BOOLEAN
    /\ slow \subseteq Voters

QuorumAuthorized ==
    committed =>
        /\ Cardinality(votes) >= Quorum
        /\ \A v \in votes : vepoch[v] = gepoch

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT QuorumAuthorized
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser will only release a controlled drug after a
quorum of on-duty pharmacists votes to authorize the dispense. Authorization is
tied to the current credentialing epoch: whenever credentials are rotated the
epoch advances and any pharmacist who has not re-synced to the new epoch is
considered stale and unauthorized. A pharmacist can be slow but never fails: a
slow pharmacist may lag behind and cannot cast a vote until it recovers, but it
does not disappear. Only a pharmacist synced to the current epoch may vote on the
pending dispense, a rotation clears the pending votes, and a dispense commits only
once a quorum of current-epoch votes has accumulated.
SAFETY PROPERTY: A dispense is committed only when a quorum of votes has accumulated and every counted vote comes from a pharmacist synced to the current credentialing epoch.

nl:

progress log. To keep the log consistent, the controllers use leader election

leader steps down so a successor can be elected. One controller can crash
silently at any moment; if the crashed controller was the leader, leadership
becomes vacant until a survivor is elected. Every append goes to the next free
log slot and advances the write cursor, so no earlier progress entry is ever
overwritten or lost even across leader changes.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The occupied log slots are always exactly the contiguous prefix below the write cursor, so no progress entry is overwritten or lost.

---- MODULE W4Od19m0p1t1 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Ids == {"a", "b", "c"}
N == 3

VARIABLES ver, baseOf, inbox, used

vars == <<ver, baseOf, inbox, used>>

Init ==
    /\ ver = 0
    /\ baseOf = [i \in 1..N |-> -1]
    /\ inbox = {}
    /\ used = {}

Create(id) ==
    /\ id \notin used
    /\ ver < N
    /\ inbox' = inbox \cup {[id |-> id, base |-> ver]}
    /\ used' = used \cup {id}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, baseOf>>

Reread(m) ==
    /\ m \in inbox
    /\ m.base # ver
    /\ inbox' = (inbox \ {m}) \cup {[id |-> m.id, base |-> ver]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, baseOf, used>>

Commit(m) ==
    /\ m \in inbox
    /\ m.base = ver
    /\ ver < N
    /\ ver' = ver + 1
    /\ baseOf' = [baseOf EXCEPT ![ver + 1] = m.base]
    /\ inbox' = inbox \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED used

Idle ==
    /\ ver = N \/ (inbox = {} /\ used = Ids)
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ \E id \in Ids : Create(id)
    \/ \E m \in inbox : Reread(m)
    \/ \E m \in inbox : Commit(m)
    \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ ver \in 0..N
    /\ baseOf \in [1..N -> {-1} \cup (0..N)]
    /\ inbox \subseteq [id : Ids, base : 0..N]
    /\ used \subseteq Ids

NoLostUpdates ==
    \A i \in 1..N : (i <= ver) => (baseOf[i] = i - 1)

====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdates
nl:
A library book reservation system lets several clients update one shared book
record using optimistic locking with retry. A client reads the record's current
version, prepares an update stamped with that base version, and submits it. The
server commits an update only if its base version still matches the record's
current version; the version then advances by one. Update messages travel over a
network that may reorder them, so the server may consider pending updates in any
order. If a pending update's base version is stale (a concurrent commit already
advanced the record), it must be re-read against the current version and retried
rather than applied blindly, so that no update silently overwrites another.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Every applied update was committed against the immediately preceding version, so the update that produced version i was based on version i-1 and no update is lost.

    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ holder = NONE
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ leader' = n

    /\ UNCHANGED <<inbox, holder, grantEpoch>>

    /\ leader' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, inbox, holder, grantEpoch>>

Request(b) ==
    /\ b \notin inbox
    /\ inbox' = inbox \cup {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, epoch, holder, grantEpoch>>

    /\ leader # NONE
    /\ b \in inbox
    /\ holder = NONE
    /\ holder' = b
    /\ grantEpoch' = epoch
    /\ inbox' = inbox \ {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, epoch>>

Release ==
    /\ holder # NONE
    /\ holder' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, epoch, inbox, grantEpoch>>

    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ holder = NONE
    /\ epoch = MaxEpoch
    /\ UNCHANGED vars

    \/ LeaderFail
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Request(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Grant(b)
    \/ Release
    \/ Idle

    /\ leader \in Banks \cup {NONE}
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ inbox \subseteq Banks
    /\ holder \in Banks \cup {NONE}
    /\ grantEpoch \in {-1} \cup (0..MaxEpoch)

GrantIsCurrent ==
    (holder # NONE) => (grantEpoch = epoch)

====

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT GrantIsCurrent
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch runs through a single settlement gateway that
is a critical resource: at most one member bank may be inside the gateway at a
time. Access is coordinated by an elected leader chosen by epoch, with failover
if the leader stops. Member banks send lock requests to the leader over a network
that may reorder messages, so the leader may consider queued requests in any
order. The leader grants the gateway to at most one bank at a time and stamps the
grant with the current epoch. When leadership changes epoch, any earlier grant
becomes stale and must not admit a bank; a new leader is only elected while the
gateway is free. A bank inside the gateway releases it before anyone else enters.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever a bank holds the settlement gateway, its grant carries the current epoch, so no stale grant from a superseded leader admits a bank.
